propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolvable and require_authenticated is off, hiding failures from logs
fsck authorship tally is summed store-wide without per-env breakdown, making single-env signing failures invisible behind healthy env volume
beb1 wrote 8914 unsigned Unknown-authored events undetected for a month due to silent skip path and uncounted per-env reporting
AC2: fsck must report as a counted UNSIGNED_ENV issue any env_id with zero signed events or all Unknown-authored events, gated to envs active after store's first signed event adoption
